channel.title: Dan Patrick Show (Filtered)
channel.description: Daily DP Show episodes without C&R or Best Of clips.
channel.itunes:author: Dan Patrick

item.title: Hour 1 - Waiting on LeBron, Running Back Greatness Factors
item.description:
Dan explains why it isn't the worst thing that we're all waiting on LeBron James to make a decision & how he's earned that right, then him and Danettes debate all the factors that makes a running back "great." 

See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.
item.itunes:author: Dan Patrick

item.title: Hour 2 - Nick Pappas, Taco Bell Lettuce
item.description:
Dan is joined by NFL Director Nick Pappas to discuss the ongoing conversation about the turf vs. natural grass in NFL stadiums. Dan and the Danettes talk about the lettuce issues plaguing the country & debate how sometimes it is appropriate to eat Taco Bell,

See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.
item.itunes:author: Dan Patrick

item.title: Hour 3 - Drew Brees, Andrew Brandt
item.description:
Dan is joined by NFL Hall of Famer & NFL game analyst Drew Brees to talk about NFL stadiums inserting real grass for the World Cup but having artificial turf for NFL games. Dan is then joined by author and former Packers Vice President Andrew Brandt to discuss the state of NIL in college athletics.

See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.
item.itunes:author: Dan Patrick

item.title: Hour 1- Where will LeBron go + The Odessey REVIEW
item.description:
Dan Patrick talks Lebron James and where he possibly might go in the NBA, Dan and the danettes reviews The Odessey and talks Christopher Nolan .

See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.
item.itunes:author: Dan Patrick

item.title: Hour 2- SEC Drama + Vincent Goodwill Jr.
item.description:
Dan shares his opinion on SEC and its decision to possibly separate itself from college football. ESPN NBA Senior Writer Vincent Goodwill Jr. joins the show.

See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.
item.itunes:author: Dan Patrick

item.title: Hour 1 – Caitlin Clark not in the 3 Point Contest, Have you read Homer?
item.description:
Caitlin Clark and Sabrina Ionescu will not be in the WNBA’s 3-point contest, with conflicting reports on whether or not they were invited in the first place. Dan can’t understand it, why wouldn’t you be asking for your biggest names and a two-time defending champ in Ionescu? Dan talks about the Odyssey and why Homer doesn’t have a last name (or a first?)

See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.
item.itunes:author: Dan Patrick

item.title: Hour 2- Dan talks ESPN layoffs, Matt Damon
item.description:
Dan gets asked about the layoffs hitting the Mothership, and talks about his belief in letting someone go with dignity rather than haphazardly as ESPN is doing. Hollywood superstar Matt Damon joins Dan to talk about filming the Odyssey, getting cut for the role and trying not to get hurt; plus working with Christopher Nolan, how the movie was carried by Samantha Morton and reveals how much he’s bench pressing.

See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.
item.itunes:author: Dan Patrick

item.title: Hour 3- Chris Simms defends putting Tom Brady #9 all time, Heather Dinich talks Lane Kiffin
item.description:
Pro football analyst Chris Simms joins Dan to talk about his all-time quarterback rankings, why he puts Peyton Manning first and he spars with Dan over his placement of Tom Brady and explains why he doesn’t think he was ever the best quarterback in the league in any single year. ESPN college football insider Heather Dinich discusses LSU head coach Lane Kiffin as he enters the crosshairs of other SEC coaches. 

See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.
item.itunes:author: Dan Patrick

item.title: 7/22 Hour 3- NFL training camp headlines , Matt Damon dramatic change for movie roles
item.description:
Dan and the Danettes predict what might be in the headlines with multiple NFL teams opening up for training camp, Dan talks about  upcoming guest , actor Matt Damon and his dramatic weight loss for his newest movie and brings up other actors who went through physical changes for movie roles

See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.
item.itunes:author: Dan Patrick

item.title: Hour 3- LeBron signs with the 76ers, should Dan do another hour?
item.description:
A massive Friday news bomb hits as LeBron James is expected to sign with the Philadelphia 76ers, Dan and the Danettes react as east coast basketball is set for a massive resurgence. Can you visualize LeBron in a Sixers jersey?

See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.
item.itunes:author: Dan Patrick

item.title: Hour 2 - Incident with the Golf Bros, Joey Votto
item.description:
Dan shares a story about where he and the Danettes were accosted for their dress on the country club golf course. What’s even the etiquette for this? Former MLB star Joey Votto is set to join Bob Costas in the NBC broadcast booth and discusses that transition in his life, plus debates with Dan about how steroid era players should be handled and why he doesn’t want someone telling him how he should feel about a player’s legacy.

See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.
item.itunes:author: Dan Patrick

item.title: Hour 1 - Tyreek Hill a Hall of Famer? Sabrina Ionescu debacle continues
item.description:
Tyreek Hill struggles to get back from injury as he tells the press he has no power in his left leg. Dan and the Danettes discuss his already-storied career. The controversy over Sabrina Ionescu’s exclusion from the WNBA 3-point contest continues as confusion reigns. A very notable exclusion from Chris Simm’s top 10 all-time quarterbacks list is brought up.

See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.
item.itunes:author: Dan Patrick

item.title: Hour 3 – Breach of Etiquette, Jim Jackson
item.description:
DP took some of the BRGs out to the golf course and there may have been some etiquette snafus during the round at Dan’s private club. And NBA legend Jim Jackson stops by and has some definite opinions about LeBron James’ decision to head to Philly.

See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.
item.itunes:author: Dan Patrick

item.title: Hour 2 – Dan Woike, Best and Worst
item.description:
NBA insider Dan Woike drops by to weigh in on LeBron James heading to Philadelphia and the reactions across the league. Plus, Dan and the Danettes provide their best and worst of the weekend.

See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.
item.itunes:author: Dan Patrick

item.title: Hour 1 – Reaction to LeBron’s Decision, 49ers Making It Weird
item.description:
Dan had absolutely no problem with LeBron James decision to take a minimum salary and chasing a ring with the Philadelphia 76ers. And he wonders exactly what was behind the San Francisco 49ers attempts to keep the details of HC Kyle Shanhan’s recent car accident under wraps.

See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.
item.itunes:author: Dan Patrick

item.title: Hour 3 – Charles Barkley, Ring Chasing
item.description:
Hall of Fame hooper and basketball icon, Charles Barkley joins the show to weigh in on LeBron’s move to Philadelphia and the rest of the NBA offseason. Plus, DP takes calls and the Danettes chime in on famous players who also chased rings.

See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.
item.itunes:author: Dan Patrick

item.title: Hour 2 – Man Cave Maneuvering, Tisha Thompson
item.description:
Dan and the Danettes go behind the scenes and air out the contentious office arrangements for the Back Room Guys. And investigative reporter Tisha Thompson drops by to share some of the details behind here “30 for 30” documentary about Shohei Ohtani.

See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.
item.itunes:author: Dan Patrick

item.title: Hour 1 – Vita Vea Wants Out, Kyle Shanahan Situation Is Sus, Michael Strahan
item.description:
DP reacts to the news that Buccaneers DT Vita Vea wants out of Tampa, asks some pertinent questions about the Kyle Shanahan car accident story, and talks to NFL Hall of Fame DE Michael Strahan about Aaron Donald’s possible return to the NFL.

See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.
item.itunes:author: Dan Patrick

item.title: Hour 3 – Paul Finebaum, First Bites
item.description:
College football insider Paul Finebaum stops by to weigh in on the big sponsorship deals announced by Ohio State and Notre Dame, and he previews the upcoming season. And neither Dan nor the Danettes can wrap their head around the concept of “first bites” at a restaurant.

See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.
item.itunes:author: Dan Patrick

item.title: Hour 2 – Chase Daniel, Titans’ Chances
item.description:
Former NFL QB and current analyst Chase Daniel drops by to preview the quarterbacking situations throughout the league. And Dan gets a tip from a source who thinks the Titans will be a playoff team this season, so the Danettes break down their chances.

See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.
item.itunes:author: Dan Patrick

item.title: Hour 1 – Baker Mayfield Is a Bargain, Aaron Rodgers’ Happy Wife
item.description:
Dan digs into the NFL offseason moves happening around the league and thinks Baker Mayfield is a bargain. Plus, DP and the Danettes consider Aaron Rodgers’ recent comments about consulting his new wife about his impending retirement.

See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.
item.itunes:author: Dan Patrick

item.title: Hour 3 – Clippers Investigation Stalled, Draymond Loves Him Some Draymond, Ahman Green Parkinson’s Disease
item.description:
The Clippers scandal continues towards its second year as reports signal the NBA might not be able to rule until 2027. Draymond Green tries to weigh in on Jalen Brunson and the Knicks and he’s once again overvaluing his own contributions to his team. Former Packers great Ahman Green says he’s got early onset Parkinson’s disease as questions continue about brain health for NFL players.

See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.
item.itunes:author: Dan Patrick

item.title: Hour 2 – LeBron’s “Last Dance,” Ross Tucker
item.description:
As if there weren’t enough vectors to compare LeBron James and Michael Jordan, now a new documentary aims to create “The Last Dance” for LeBron and even follow him for the season with the 76ers. Dan asks former NFL player and current analyst Ross Tucker how he got invited to the Travis Kelce/Taylor Swift wedding. Tucker shares his highlights of the wedding including his wife hugging Tom Cruise, and he dishes on the Cleveland Browns quarterbacking situation.

See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.
item.itunes:author: Dan Patrick

item.title: Hour 1 – Patrick Mahomes Comeback Tracker, Preseason Favorites, Jesse Newell
item.description:
Dan says no news is good news when it comes to NFL training camp as the Los Angeles Rams are the overwhelming favorite to win the Super Bowl and Patrick Mahomes is favored to win Comeback Player of the Year. And Chiefs beat writer Jesse Newell joins Dan to discuss Kansas City quarterback Patrick Mahomes, his journey back from injury and how the Chiefs are handling his return.

See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.
item.itunes:author: Dan Patrick

item.title: Hour 3 – Cowboys Offense the Greatest? Matt Barrows
item.description:
Cowboys quarterback Dak Prescott has a new nickname for his offense, but do the accolades match the reality? San Francisco 49ers beat writer Matt Barrows joins Dan to discuss the continuing strange story around HC Kyle Shanahan and the confusion surrounding his traffic accident.

See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.
item.itunes:author: Dan Patrick

item.title: Hour 2 – A Bet in the WNBA Goes Wrong, Jeff Passan
item.description:
The WNBA trips over their own feet again. Angel Reese and Paige Bueckers get caught joking about a wager between themselves at the All-Star Game, and now the social media post is gone. MLB insider Jeff Passan joins Dan to explain what he’s hearing about the trade deadline and how it’s not a matter of if Tigers pitcher Tarik Skubal will be traded, but where.

See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.
item.itunes:author: Dan Patrick

item.title: Hour 1 - Baker Mayfield Feels the Disrespect in Tampa Bay, Rick Stroud
item.description:
Buccaneers quarterback Baker Mayfield is at camp without a contract extension, and it sounds like the relationship is souring. Bucs beat reporter Rick Stroud stops in to talk to Dan about the Buccaneers and how the situation has developed with the team, Baker Mayfield and Vita Vea.

See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.
item.itunes:author: Dan Patrick

item.title: Hour 3 – Wizards Woes, Batting Title Is Boring
item.description:
DP and the Danettes consider just how bad the Washington Wizards will be next season. And they wonder if anybody will care about the MLB batting title ever again.

See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.
item.itunes:author: Dan Patrick

item.title: Hour 2 – Larry Fitzgerald, Kyle Whittingham Rivalry Downer
item.description:
Newest Pro Football Hall of Famer, Arizona Cardinals WR Larry Fitzgerald drops by to talk with Dan about his upcoming induction and talk a little bit about his extraordinary career. And Michigan HC Kyle Whittingham tries to downplay the fierce rivalry with Ohio State and fans aren’t having it.

See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.
